patterns.message: Import design-system components from '@bledi/design-system' (src/index.ts), not component internals.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Raw hex color — use a design-system color token via var().
Raw px value — use a design-system spacing token via var().

no-restricted-syntax.selector: Literal[value=/font-family\s*:\s*(?!['\"]?(?:Camera Plain|Plus Jakarta Sans|IBM Plex Mono|Playfair Display))/i]
no-restricted-syntax.message: Font not provided by the design system. Available: Camera Plain, Plus Jakarta Sans, IBM Plex Mono, Playfair Display.
<Alert> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: tone, icon, children.
<Alert> tone must be one of 'notice' | 'neutral' | 'outline' | 'danger'.
<Avatar> doesn't accept that prop. Declared props: initial, size, tone.
<Avatar> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
<Avatar> tone must be one of 'brand' | 'muted'.

<Button> size must be one of 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'.
